run_flat_scene_generation: run the script to generate N flat Minecraft scenes and dump them to a pickle file
build_flat_scenes_with_distribution: build flat Minecraft scenes using a configurable action distribution for MOVE, BUILD, DESTROY, DIG, COPY, FILL, SPAWN, and DANCE
generate_scenes_with_argparse: generate a specified number of flat scenes using argparse arguments --target and --N
create_blocktype_list_from_color_map: create a list of allowed Minecraft block types by iterating over COLOR_BID_MAP and resolving names via BLOCK_DATA
pickle_dump_generated_scenes: pickle dump a list of generated flat scene dictionaries to a target directory file
